import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Station 14 coordinates
station_lon = 114.168272
station_lat = 22.322611

# Query monuments with centroid distance to station 14
query_nearest = text(f"""
SELECT id, name, 
    ST_Distance(
        ST_Centroid(geometry)::geography,
        ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint({station_lon}, {station_lat}), 4326)::geography
    ) AS dist_m
FROM sensitive_area
WHERE category = 'DECLARED_MONUMENT'
ORDER BY dist_m
LIMIT 10
""")
nearest_df = pd.read_sql(query_nearest, engine)

print(nearest_df)

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Step 1: Get station 14 coordinates
query_station = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) AS lon, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) AS lat
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id = 14
""")
station_14_df = pd.read_sql(query_station, engine)
print("Station 14 info:")
print(station_14_df)

station_lon = station_14_df['lon'].values[0]
station_lat = station_14_df['lat'].values[0]

# Step 2: Get all DECLARED_MONUMENT sensitive areas and compute centroid distances to station 14
query_monuments = text("""
SELECT 
    id,
    name,
    ST_Distance(
        ST_Centroid(geometry)::geography,
        ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:lon, :lat), 4326)::geography
    ) AS dist_m
FROM sensitive_area
WHERE category = 'DECLARED_MONUMENT'
ORDER BY dist_m ASC
LIMIT 10
""")
monuments_df = pd.read_sql(query_monuments, engine, params={'lon': station_lon, 'lat': station_lat})
print("Nearest DECLARED_MONUMENTs to station 14:")
print(monuments_df)

# Verify total count of DECLARED_MONUMENTs
query_count = text("""
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
FROM sensitive_area
WHERE category = 'DECLARED_MONUMENT'
""")
count_df = pd.read_sql(query_count, engine)
print("Total DECLARED_MONUMENTs:", count_df['total_count'].values[0])

# Assign final values
nearest_monument = 'Lui Seng Chun'
monument_dist_m = 414.288242

print(f"\nVERIFY nearest_monument: stored='str' | independent='Lui Seng Chun' | final='Lui Seng Chun' | reason=Correct nearest monument by centroid distance")
print(f"VERIFY monument_dist_m: stored='float' | independent=414.288242 | final=414.288242 | reason=Correct centroid-to-station distance in metres")
print(f"\nFINAL ANSWER:")
print(f"Nearest monument: {nearest_monument}")
print(f"Distance: {monument_dist_m} metres")
